slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.8.1
slides.subtitle: From the drag strip to the streets

slides.title: Stage up. Risk the keys.
slides.summary: Race a drag weekend at Alder, then chase pink slips after dark.
facts: Pick from 19 classes in four leagues, including Outlaw Drag League
Stage at the tree, qualify, run eliminations or bet on heats
Join Car Meets: beat five bosses, defend your title or win back your car

slides.title: Tune it your way
slides.summary: See your tune at work with upgraded afterfire flames and rolling coal.
facts: Set mixture, spark and boost, then save your tune maps
A rich mix or late spark can leave fuel to ignite in a hot exhaust
Diesels roll coal under load when the tune delivers more fuel than the air can burn
Pick Regular, Premium, E85, M100 or Nitro 90; fill two tanks separately

slides.title: Build it. Put it to work.
slides.summary: Fit your next drag build, or hop in a work truck and grab a new load.
facts: Fit slicks, radials, front runners or wide front tires for FWD builds
Dyno and refuel Racing Team cars; export builds with their fuel setup
Job Broker routes new loads; BeamEats picks reachable drop-offs

slides.title: Drift and stay in the loop
slides.summary: Set a new best at Drift Playground, then swipe down on your phone to catch up.
facts: Drift Playground replaces Drift Loop Remaster; five others get new goals
Notification Center groups missed invites, job offers and alerts by app
Watch rain and fog roll in gradually; the Weather app shows when rain is falling

columns.heading: Racing and cars
items: Cleaner staging and qualifying; withdraw an entry after a wreck
Fairer lane calls, steadier opponent launches and straight-line braking
Pink-slip prizes keep their value, upgrades, wear and gearbox mode
Smoother Racing Team finishes, payouts and garage deliveries
Correct tire fitment and wear; derby repairs restore popped tires
Reinstall certified engine packages in their original cars
Boost adapts to transmission swaps; clutch limits follow the tune
Better recovery for owned cars after physics failures

columns.heading: Jobs and garages
items: Rental trucks use bays they fit; flatbeds require fifth-wheel tractors
Work trailers unhitch at drop-off; manual recovery trucks shift after reloading
Loaner cuts apply once; cargo and return screens are more reliable
Company vehicle locks show the missing skill or reputation
Taxi rides recover from crashes and don't charge for paused time
Buy from storage garages with space; repairs count cars correctly
Dealer filters ignore case, and modern Bruckell stock can include the Ravix
Safer auction balances; fixes for Tuning Shop fuel charges and stored parts

columns.heading: Menus, world and saves
items: High Contrast keeps phone colours; profile search accepts typing
Phone balances and car values stay current; OBD clears repaired faults
Keep your driver model and door glass when entering cars
Map travel prefers marked parking; Linux imports and maps are more reliable
Large parts collections load; insurance keeps saving after a car sale
Failed saves show an error instead of leaving you stuck
Career weather no longer takes over Free Roam
Less background work during long sessions, saves and phone use
